verdict.rationale: n8n's Code node explicitly supports both JavaScript and Python plus npm packages as a workflow step, confirmed by docs/GitHub descriptions ('Code When You Need It') and corroborated hands-on by community users who describe using 'custom code blocks (JS and Python only, with limited ability to import libraries)'. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of Python sandboxing/library limitations and deeper docs on the Code node's execution environment.
